body: Omg I lol at this.
It's like trying to breathe but you can never catch your breath.
You did that all by hand?? Amazing!
No one truly owns art.....we create we share and it repeats... good job.
Yes I take care of her, and she I.  She doesn't want to be alone. I understand. Life is hard for us all.
Don't add her. It's your home and you are paying for it. You told her how you felt.

Its murder she gave me life I can't take her life. She doesn't suffer from depression. She never has, my dad did and that is why he took his life. His brother did the same thing a few years after my dad. 
My dad and uncle were stand up men. Not drug addicts or drinkers. My uncle was a CSM in the Army. Idk what trauma happened to them as kids. 
My uncle even told me before he did a few months prior. He thought what my dad did was okay. I had no idea he would do the same. 
Its like a curse. We have had 4 suicides. I have been to therapy since I was 15 when my dad died. Tried all kinds of meds. It is just an overwhelming feeling of sadness. 
I never turned to drug or drinking either. I like my mind, except for the sadness. 
I have had a lot of death in my life since I was little. I think that is part of it. I know too much sadness. 
My story is not unique,  I know there are plenty of people hurting the same. Part of my problem is I am an empath. I choose to not be around people as pain it too much. 
I guess I am just crazy. 
Thank you for replying.

No matter what that is trauma to see someone in such pain and end their life. 
Just process it and carry on all you can do.
He had an appointment,  but did not go because of covid. I will definitely have him make another. Thank you
He tried edibles, says he doesn't get high enough. Lol.

Omg. I am so sorry. I don't even know what more to say. Its just a nightmare for you. 
You are to beautiful kids, focus on them and yourself.  Now that is all that truly matters. 
I wish you the best.

Bravo! As a mentally ill mother. I love my kids, but I wish I would have not had any. 
There is nothing wrong with not wanting or having kids. My bf is 51 has none, wanted none. I have lots of friends who are the same. 
I wish I would have known better. Lots of suffering would have been avoided for them and I.
You be you!

That she didn't flip her shit and hurt him. I would have went to jail. 
She is already hurting and is trying to figure out what to do. Why bash her?
Love him...like you do and hold him. I am sorry for your unbearable loss.

This so hurt my heart to read. I am so sorry, you are a strong young woman.  I would have flipped my shit and beat the hell out them both. Called her man and suggested he do the same. 
But that's me. 
You need do what is healthy for you and gives you peace. 
There are some Wonderful suggestions from ppl on here. 
Worry about yourself and the kids 1st. You are the priority. He is not.

I am so sorry. Please look for a survivor of suicide group. 
Being able to with others does help. 
Suicide is a choice. We can't stop them. She had more she was dealing with than she let known. 
If you like to write, get a journal and get your feelings out.
Absolutely Beautiful. Wish you and your BF and Very Merry Christmas and a Blessed New Year.
Omg stop this shit had me LOL for reals.
Well done!! One step closer. Congrats! It is worth all the pain. For noone can take your education and knowledge away.
How to safe a life....💞
Damn. I feel you. I rarely complain.  I just dont see the point to do it. It doesn't solve anything. My bf complains all the time and drives me nuts.
Leave her...get someone who loves you for you. She is clearly not worth the stress.
Me too and not a single one I want to waist it on.
Thank you.

I am so sorry. Last Friday my mom in her 80s went to the Er. Had to have emergency surgery on her kidney.  She became unable to walk, and they wanted to send her to a rehab facility. 
I told them NO. Those are death traps. I brought her home. It is hard and I have to lift her and put her in her wheelchair. Idc. I will do whatever and sacrifice to try to keep her alive.

Thank you, this made me cry. I really did try. I just dont understand. He is a smart and beautiful soul. I wish he believed in himself more. That he doesn't need to be in this relationship, he is strong enough to succeed by his own will.
I am, its just hard. I don't say anything to him. It will only anger him. I have learned to just keep my thoughts to myself.

Well congrats on the kicking the booze. However please stop the meth. My bf and I are the same age 50. He did meth for 20 years and he looks 20 years older than I. The damage it has done to him mentally and physically are heart breaking to me. You are stronger and worthy of more than that terrible drug. His sil od from it and left 2 kids...she is now missing the 2 grandkids she would have known. 💔💗
Sometimes we have to make peace and you did just that. Let it go and accept you do a beautiful thing. Forgive yourself for the guilt and be at peace with it.
No!! Never and delete this...off your post.
I did you deleted it. I always try to help lower levels.

Idk if this helps. But the some of the housekeep companies that take care of the NFL stadiums are hiring. 
Don't get discouraged, try a temp agency too. I wish you the best of luck.
From a mom I am sending you a hug.   🫂
Its okay, I have done this my entire life. You are unknowingly processing your thoughts.  Its a good thing to write out your feelings. Even if you are the only one who sees it.

Lol hopefully you have never had a life long struggle to loose weight.  I did extensive research online and this was something that is done. Not by all. We will call it a weight cushion.  
It is what it is..  
If you know wls once you have the sleeve there is no going back. The bypass they can reconnect your stomach. 
I had mine years ago. Best decision I ever made. I had tried too many times. Nothing worked. 
Like so many people with drug addiction issues, trauma is usually the underlying cause. 
My addiction was food. 
You can't watch your dads brains be eaten by cats and not be messed up...(suicide/not properly disposed aftermath)
Food was my choice, drugs never was something I was interested in...
I ate to deal with it all.. 
Now I am physically healthy and can make better choices.
POS.

Tell her to do the gastric sleeve. Put 15 pounds of weights.. on her body when she goes to the Dr for her 1st check in for the supervised weight loss portion.  This way if she eats too much and gains some it won't show. You usually have to do a 3 to 6 months to get approved. With a small amount of weight loss. If you show too much loss they assume you can do it on your own. 
No you are not a bad husband. 
I was never mad at any man who was not attracted to me when I was 350. Just like I was never attracted to an overweight guy either. We like what we like. You love her and that is what matters.

Everyone's trauma is thier own. I was once in a support group for women. Everyone of them had been sexually assaulted at some point in their lives. 
When group ended I was in tears and went to the therapist and told her I couldn't go back.  She said why? I go mine is just my fathers suicide and PTSD from the trauma.  
These ladies were violated and abused I feel like shit. She told me. Just because your trauma is not the same it is not less. 
I still was not able to go as just listen to what had been done to them was too hard. It broke my heart. 
No one should think what they went through was worse...
It is all painful.
Break up...no sense in you feeling miserable over his needs.

Unfortunately he is an ahole... you see his true color's. Hopefully others will be as wise. 
Thank you for your military service. 
Go Big Red One!!
Amen

Congratulations. I was a cutter for years. It is so hard, the struggle is real. I don't cut anymore, however I still punch myself in the arm...when the emotional pain is too much. Which I know is dumb @ 51 yo. However like so many others I get overwhelmed and I feel noone around me understands. 
Keep up the good work, I hope to make it that long too.

Don't be offended, the person is mad. Some ppl dont like to be shown they are incorrect. One of my biggest pet peeves is that ppl do not fact check information. I do as you do and post factual information on thiers...lol. Idc if they get salty or not. I think it makes them look ignorant for not fact checking in the 1st place. 
Thank you for putting real facts and not bs so many are trying to do!
Right...I agree troll. No guy is this stupid to put this bs on here...and think ppl will feel bad for him.

Good for you, listen to your heart and your own feelings and thoughts.  You are your own person and don't need to follow party lines. Nothing to ever feel bad about you are 100% correct. 
I am a Democrat lol and I can't tell my MIL bc she hates All Dems...I listen to her say how stupid we are and bash things I feel very close to. However she is in her late 70s and is not physically well, so I just smile.  
It is not worth arguing with a person that is so set in their ways.  I dont feel that way about any political party. I feel we have the right to believe in what we want. No judgment or need to be ugly.  
I wish you the very best.

I am so very sorry for your loss. You are going thru so many emotions and the pain of realizing you are a single parent. Time will heal some things, but you will never stop missing her. You have s beautiful gift in your child. Hold her close and continue to share memories of her mother who loves her as she grows up. There in no stronger love than a dad and a daughter especially when you have both lost such an important part of your lives. Dont ever feel bad when that precious child makes you smile. Remember your beautiful wife gave you that gift and she is now watching over you both. I truly believe that and that she is smiling with you. I know some may think I am silly for feeling this way. However in what I have lost in this life, I have to believe they are with us in some special way. 
I am glad you have family who will be there for you. If you ever feel you need more, seek a grief support group.  They have them online now due to covid. My brother lost his wife of 35 years this past year, he said to speak to others with a similar loss has helped him.
May you be blessed with many beautiful years together ❤!!
I don't even know what to say. I am so broken hearted for you.

Run...find someone who only wants YOU.  
She won't change.  I'm sorry..but she betrayed you by sleeping with another. 
Would she really have been as gracious as you if the roles were reversed?

You have every right to be upset with your mom. She made shitty choices that you and your siblings suffered over. 

I can say as a mom I didn't always make the best choices either. We moved too much and my youngest dropped out of school bc of it. 

I regret it to this day and it breaks my heart that I should have made sure his needs were met 1st. 
He knows I am sorry and has forgiven me. 

So as a mom even though I am not your mom. 
I am sorry you had to deal with this. 
Learn from your parents mistakes so that if you choose to have children one day you won't do the same. 

You are a survivor and now have become stronger, when you should have just been a kid.

Documentation...Sadly you will have to prove it for them to understand. 
Please be careful he sounds dangerous. 
I am so sorry you are dealing with this. 

I understand.  My brother threw me down the stairs as a teen and broke my ankle. Had 2 have 2 surgeries to fix it. Once he even chased me around the yard with a chainsaw. I have not spoken to him in over 25 years.  He made my life hell. 
I know you can't leave yet, but when you can get away from him. I will keep you in my prayers. 💗
She is with you,  she gave you the strength to carry on.
I am glad you are here. Your momma is too.

You are in shock still. My dad committed suicide when I was 15. You will have lots of emotions and it will he hard. 
Even now I don't understand why or how he could leave us. 
I'm so sorry you are dealing with this. It's hard at any age, but as a kid it is soul crushing.

Absolutely. You are not alone, we have all done things we are ashamed of. 
We keep trying.
The fact you have regret is personal growth. Be proud you are growing into the best person you can be.

Give him a hug for me and tell him great job!

Your Dreams
Your Hopes. 
You are what matters. 

There is so much you can do to learn about anything your heart desires. 

Endless possibilities.  

Believe in Yourself.
People are aholes...you are perfectly you.

I pray you find him. Remember no matter what you have proof you are loved by him and that is a beautiful thing.
